checks.text: On first load the page shows the heading "Teleprompter" and the seeded "Welcome script" in the script list.
New script then Rehearse shows "Nothing to read yet" for the empty script.
Deleting a script offers Undo, and Undo restores it.
Duplicate adds a copy named "<name> copy".
In Step mode the arrow keys move line by line; at the end an "End" card offers Restart.
Pressing H hides the controls (clean mode) and H brings them back.
Mirror flips the reading stage horizontally; Escape returns to the editor.
The Keys dialog lists the keyboard map.
Play shows a 3-2-1 countdown, then reads.
Mode, speed and size are remembered per script across reload.
